messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — thinking about a small IA change: collapse ‘Deployments’ and ‘Dedicated’ under a single ‘Runtime’ group in the sidebar, and build robust deep-linking for model-specific routes so external dashboards can link straight to a model. Opinions? :thinking:

Jonah (Design): I like grouping by concept rather than infra type. Runtime -> Models / Capacity reads well. My only worry is discoverability for existing users who look for 'Dedicated'. Maybe add a short pill tag or tooltip for renamed items.

Devin (Eng): From a routing perspective we can support both old and new URLs with redirects. Two implementation notes: 1) canonical path should be path-based (not hash) for copy/paste. 2) need to ensure left-nav highlight works on deep links e.g. /orgs/:org/runtime/models/:modelId

Samira (A11y): Accessibility nits: when collapsing items, ensure keyboard focus order is preserved and the collapsed group has aria-expanded and an accessible name. Also breadcrumbs must be programmatically determinable (role=navigation + aria-label="Breadcrumbs").

Maya (Product): Quick user story: customers want a link to a model evaluation run that opens the console on that model and expands the right panel. Deep links should accept query params for panel state, e.g. ?panel=eval&tab=results

Jonah (Design): Example breadcrumb pattern I sketched: Runtime > Models > gpt-3.5-xl. If we surface deep links we should show the full path in the breadcrumb and allow clicking each segment to navigate. Small copy tweak: use 'Models' (plural) in the sidebar but show singular in the breadcrumb.

Devin (Eng): Proposed router rules (pseudo):
```
/console/:org/overview
/console/:org/runtime
/console/:org/runtime/models
/console/:org/runtime/models/:modelId
```
For backwards compatibility map:
```
/console/:org/dedicated -> /console/:org/runtime/capacity
/console/:org/deployments -> /console/:org/runtime/deployments
```
Redirects will be 301-ish client-side with history.replace so links don't create weird back behaviour.

Priya (PM): Good. Also want to support deep-linking from external apps where the modelId might be stale (deleted/renamed). How should the console behave? Fallback to model list and show a toast?

Lina (Docs): Recommend: if modelId not found, show a contextual banner: "Model not found — showing Models list (linked). If it's a rename, include hint: "Search for related models" with a prefilled search query. We'll document both the URL patterns and the query param contract.

Samira (A11y): UX note: when we redirect from old URLs, ensure the screen reader receives an announcement announcing the new page context (e.g., via aria-live) so users know content changed. Also client-side focus target: first meaningful h1 or the breadcrumb.

Jonah (Design): Visual: when deep-link lands on a model we should animate the sidebar expansion so users see why the highlight changed. Keep animation short (120ms). Also breadcrumbs should truncate long names with title on hover and expose full name via accessible label.

Devin (Eng): Implementation detail: left-nav highlight uses a matcher that currently expects top-level route. I can extend it to match nested routes by creating a route-to-nav-key map. Edge-case: modelId contains slashes? We enforce IDs are URL-safe (slug).

Priya (PM): Decision time: do we ship grouping + deep-links together or split? I vote ship grouping + redirects first, then deep-link query panel state in a follow-up. That way we avoid too many moving parts.

Maya (Product): Agree. MVP: reorganize sidebar, routing aliases for old names, breadcrumbs for top 2 levels, deep-link to model detail that opens core view (no panel state).

Lina (Docs): I'll draft API docs for the URL surface and the migration notes for customers.

Devin (Eng): Action items: 1) I'll add route aliases + nav matcher update (PR by end of week). 2) Add client-side redirects and history.replace.

Jonah (Design): Action: I'll make final microcopy suggestions (tooltip for 'Runtime' that lists legacy names) and the short animation spec.

Samira (A11y): I'll run a quick a11y checklist and post it here before you merge. Key checklist items I'll cover: aria-expanded, aria-labels for breadcrumbs, focus management, screen reader announcement on redirect.

Priya (PM): Great. Anyone object to scheduling a short review on Friday after the PR lands? :thumbsup: for yes

Maya (Product): :+1:

Jonah (Design): +1

Devin (Eng): +1 (will tag the PR)
